intent: The scrolling listbox inside a Combobox's popup that renders the items left after filtering.
typical_uses: The list of a combobox's filtered items, flat or in groups

dont_use_when.situation: The message shown when no item matches the query

invariants.text: When children is a function, the list calls it once for every item (or every group, when the root's `items` holds groups) left after filtering, with the item and its index; a node child is rendered as given, unfiltered.
The list renders with role "listbox", and with `aria-multiselectable` when the root has `multiple`; with the root's `grid` it renders role "grid" instead.

a11y.by: the primitive's Combobox.List sets role="listbox" and aria-multiselectable; combobox.test.tsx asserts the popup is found by role listbox once opened and is absent while closed

children.states: children is either React nodes or a function of an item and its index returning React nodes
children.because: `ReactNode | ((item: any, index: number) => ReactNode)` - a React node and a function have no JSON Schema representation.

render.states: render replaces the rendered element with one the caller supplies
render.because: Base UI's render prop takes an element or a function of the list's own state, so its type is a union of a React element and a callback - neither expressible in JSON Schema.

style.states: style accepts a function of the list's state as well as a plain style object
style.because: Base UI widens React's `CSSProperties` to `CSSProperties | ((state) => CSSProperties)` so a caller can style off the primitive's own state (empty). A JSON Schema `object` would reject the function form, so nothing is asserted; the kit's own styling goes through combobox.module.css, not through this.

good.title: A flat list rendered from the root's items

bad.title: The no-results message put inside the list
bad.why: ComboboxEmpty belongs beside the list, as a child of ComboboxContent; inside the listbox it becomes a non-option child of it.

children.description: TS: ReactNode | ((item: any, index: number) => ReactNode).
